web.sidebar_expanded_width: 280px inferred from component runtime width contract

layout.rail_geometry: 56px rail with 36x36 controls centered by 10px side padding
layout.region_area: flex 1 session/workspace browser; right negative margin lets scrollbar sit at sidebar edge
layout.footer: bottom pinned settings and additive footer actions

expanded.brand: full wordmark in primary ink, clickable, no hover chrome
expanded.icon_buttons: 28x28 circular transparent controls with secondary ink

collapsed.brand_toggle: rail brand mark is shown by default; hover swaps to panel icon
collapsed.labels: hidden by max-width 0 or unmounted rail layout

collapsing.content: frozen expanded layout fades out over 150ms
collapsing.rail_entry: upper controls translate in from 49px right edge over 150ms after settle

dragging.frame_transition: disabled so drag handles track pointer exactly

behavior.reduced_motion: all sidebar and handle animations disabled
behavior.scrollbar_policy: quietBars sets sidebar scrollbar thumb and hover thumb to transparent without changing gutter
behavior.details_handle: details resize pill appears only on details column hover, handle hover, or drag

workspace_navigation.hover_behavior: session time hides while row action buttons appear

iconography.source: custom primitive icon set and brand components
iconography.special_affordance: collapsed rail logo swaps to panel icon on hover

version_display.reason: No reusable version badge was found in the extracted sidebar/navigation source files.

user_menu.pattern: Settings and footer action seats are bottom pinned; dropdown behavior should use shared Menu component rather than bespoke menu styling.
user_menu.menu_cell: 40px min-height, 10px radius, 14px/22px label, optional leading icon and trailing check

permission_filtering.notes: Navigation rows are runtime slot/session driven. No static role-permission menu table was identified in the extracted files.

persistence.notes: Layout state is handled by ui-layout runtime stores; no literal localStorage key was identified in the CSS/source subset read for this extraction.

rules: Use buttons for logo/new-session/toggle controls, not plain clickable divs.
Preserve focus-visible states on menu and card controls.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling rail, fade, and handle transitions.
Keep icon-only rail controls named with aria-label or tooltip text in implementation.

integration_notes: Treat the sidebar as an app shell column, not a floating card.
Keep the collapsed rail at 56px with 36px controls; widening it changes the source project feel.
Do not replace the slide/fade collapse with instant label hiding.
Use shared menu geometry for user/settings/catalog menus.
